constraints.personas_visual_identity_check: CHECK (((photo_path IS NULL) OR (avatar_url IS NULL))) NOT VALID

constraints.post_metrics_post_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (post_id) REFERENCES scheduled_posts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

persona_images_owner_all.qual:
((auth.uid() = user_id) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM personas p
  WHERE ((p.id = persona_images.persona_id) AND (p.user_id = auth.uid())))))
persona_images_owner_all.withCheck:
((auth.uid() = user_id) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM personas p
  WHERE ((p.id = persona_images.persona_id) AND (p.user_id = auth.uid())))))

constraints.fk_persona_images_persona: FOREIGN KEY (persona_id) REFERENCES personas(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.scheduled_posts_experiment_link_check: CHECK ((((experiment_id IS NULL) = (variant_id IS NULL)) AND ((experiment_id IS NULL) OR (experiment_pair IS NOT NULL)) AND ((experiment_pair IS NULL) OR (experiment_pair >= 1))))
constraints.scheduled_posts_experiment_variant_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (experiment_id, variant_id) REFERENCES experiment_variants(experiment_id, variant_id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.post_metrics_done_post_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (post_id) REFERENCES scheduled_posts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

experiment_variants_select_own.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM experiments e
  WHERE ((e.id = experiment_variants.experiment_id) AND (e.user_id = auth.uid()))))

constraints.experiment_variants_experiment_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (experiment_id) REFERENCES experiments(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

persona_default_accounts_owner_all.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM personas p
  WHERE ((p.id = persona_default_accounts.persona_id) AND (p.user_id = auth.uid()))))
persona_default_accounts_owner_all.withCheck:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM personas p
  WHERE ((p.id = persona_default_accounts.persona_id) AND (p.user_id = auth.uid()))))

constraints.persona_default_accounts_persona_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (persona_id) REFERENCES personas(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

progress_history_owner_all.qual:
((auth.uid() = user_id) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM scheduled_posts p
  WHERE ((p.id = scheduled_post_progress_history.post_id) AND (p.user_id = auth.uid())))))
progress_history_owner_all.withCheck:
((auth.uid() = user_id) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM scheduled_posts p
  WHERE ((p.id = scheduled_post_progress_history.post_id) AND (p.user_id = auth.uid())))))

constraints.fk_progress_history_post: FOREIGN KEY (post_id) REFERENCES scheduled_posts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
